en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5632 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Riʾab from Abu Ubaydah from Abu Jafar (as) regarding a man who passed away and left behind his wife, his sister, and his grandfather.
Imam (as) said: "This inheritance is divided into four shares: the wife receives one-fourth, the sister receives one share, and the grandfather receives two shares."
